help.title: Help & Support
help.intro: Answers to the most common questions — and if you're still stuck, write us directly.

faqs.q: How do I create a group?
faqs.a: Tap the + button at the bottom, choose "Create group" and follow the steps. You can set category, date, location and max participants.

faqs.q: What's the difference between groups and clubs?
faqs.a: Groups are for single activities or events. Clubs are lasting communities whose members meet up regularly.
Open the person's profile, scroll to the bottom and tap "Block". After that they can no longer message you or see your profile.

faqs.q: How do I change my interests or profile picture?
faqs.a: Go to your Profile and tap "Edit profile". From there you can update your photo, bio, interests, favorite song and everything else.

Check Settings to make sure push notifications are enabled. On iOS, you have to open the app from the Home Screen (not from Safari). If your browser has blocked notifications, you'll need to allow them in the browser settings.

faqs.q: How do I report inappropriate content or a user?
faqs.a: Every profile and group has a "Report" link at the bottom. Briefly describe the issue — we review every report.

faqs.q: How do I delete my account?
faqs.a: Settings → at the very bottom, tap "Delete account". This is permanent and cannot be undone.
Pro unlocks direct messages, exclusive "For You" deals and extended member previews. You can cancel anytime from Settings.
